race.comment: In an open race FREEDOM FLAME (6) looks hard to toss on a seven-day back-up. Settled just behind the leaders in a slightly shorter race at the Parks track last Saturday then finished with great determination to get the prize narrowly. Competitive at Listed level the run prior so she is up to this, particularly with 3.5kgs less today than last weekend. BAMYAN BUDDHA (3) took out the 1500m Gawler Cup two back then didn't run a strong 1800m here on Melbourne Cup Day at Listed level. Has a strong long-term record at the mile so he comes right into calculations. BOOTLEGGER (4) was less than two lengths behind BAMYAN BUDDHA in the Gawler Cup and has been freshened up since. Races well here and looks favourably treated after the claim. The consistent SHADOW EAGLE (16) made up a few lengths to finish a close third behind FREEDOM FLAME at the Parks course last weekend. Will be hard to hold out with the light weight. CHICAGO STORM (1) is fitter for two runs back and cannot be ruled out.
